citation: Mari A, Bagger JI, Ferrannini E, et al. Mechanisms of the Incretin Effect in Subjects with Normal Glucose Tolerance and Patients with Type 2 Diabetes. PLoS ONE. 2013.
protocol: Oral glucose 25, 75 or 125 g and, on separate days over 4 weeks, three matched isoglycaemic IV glucose infusions; morning after 10 h overnight fast
population: n=8 NGT (negative family history) + n=8 T2D, matched; 3 males each; age 57+/-11 y; BMI 29+/-3 (mean+/-SD)
